split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before timing workload, workload kind, generated artifact, evidence-log row, migration-only row, runner bucket, cache proof, docs output, command-surface output, package artifact, or retired-surface claim
split_policy.positive_rule: compiler throughput rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners; timing workloads, source-surface rows, workload manifests, perf summaries, cache proofs, docs outputs, command-surface outputs, tmp packages, and provenance rows are not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: generated docs, command surfaces, perf summaries, cache artifacts, tmp packages, workload manifest rows, source-surface rows, artifact-surface rows, optimization-policy rows, validation-tier rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, and migration-only rows are provenance-only until a phase owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, alternate acceptance path, cache-recovery, cache-only, runner-only, docs-only, command-surface-only, package-only, generated-only, evidence-log, and migration-only claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
